newsitem.title: NIGERIA: Boy's headless corpse sparks Nigerian riot.
newsitem.headline: Boy's headless corpse sparks Nigerian riot.

text.p: The exhumation of a boy's headless corpse sparked riots in the eastern Nigerian city of Owerri in which a hotel and some dozen houses were destroyed, local newspapers reported on Wednesday.
The corpse, along with parts of other human bodies in nine shallow graves, was recovered on Tuesday from the grounds of a hotel, following the arrest of a man in possession of a human head on Friday.
The Champion newspaper said a mob burned down the hotel, before turning its attention to buildings belonging to local chiefs linked to the hotel's owner. Other papers carried the report.
The mob was said to have expressed disgust with an upsurge of ritual murders in the area.
Police named the dead boy as 11-year-old Ikechukwu Okonoko. He had been hawking groundnuts on the street when he was abducted.
His suspected killer, Innocent Ekeanyanwu, died in police custody at the weekend.
The Champion quoted police spokesman Johnson Adenola as saying Ekeanyanwu died in his sleep on Sunday. He added that several other people had been arrested in connection with the killings.
Traditional medicine and witchcraft in a number of West African cultures has made use of human body parts.
